meta.title: GoCar Automation Architecture — Live vs. Gap
meta.subtitle: Every box below is real: traced directly from Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Solid green = live today. Dashed = not yet built.

headers.title: PROSPECT → ACTIVATION
headers.goal: Convert a signup into a verified, booking-ready rider

headers.title: FIRST BOOKING
headers.goal: Drive and confirm the first trip

nodes.label:
Onboarding Step 1 —
Activation Nudges
nodes.description: GC_Onboarding_Step1 series (18 running journeys, one per interval cohort). Branches by platform, escalating reminders to upload licence documents.

nodes.label:
Verification Confirmation
(Opt-in / Opt-out)
nodes.description: gocar_verification_email journey. Fires when account_verified__c = Yes. Splits by email_unsubscribe status — only ~20% of the historic base ever reaches the opted-in branch.

nodes.label:
Onboarding Step 2 —
First-Trip Push (€10)
nodes.description: GC_Onboarding_Step2 series. Post-verification activation push offering a first-trip discount code.

nodes.label:
Platform Split
(iOS / Android / Other)
nodes.description: Recurring decision-split pattern used across GoCar's live journeys — branches to push notification for app users, email for the rest.

nodes.label: First Trip Booked
nodes.description: gocar_first_trip_booked journey. Fires on Account update when ftu_booking_date__c is set and total_trips__c was 0/null.

nodes.label:
Post-Trip Review /
NPS Request
nodes.description: Pre_NPS_Touchpoint_Gocar. Fires ~1 hour after a trip, branches by platform, asks for feedback/NPS.

nodes.label: 2nd-Booking Nurture
nodes.description: No automation exists to encourage a second booking after the first trip.

nodes.label:
Occasion Reminder
(moving, DIY, holidays)
nodes.description: GoCar's usage is need-triggered (moving house, day trips, big shop) — no occasion-based reminder flow exists yet.

nodes.label:
Loyalty Points
Reminder
nodes.description: GoCar's loyalty programme launched June 2024 with 79% satisfaction and 3k monthly users — but has no lifecycle automation behind it beyond one historic one-off push.

nodes.label: Birthday / Anniversary
nodes.description: No date-based personal milestone flow exists.

nodes.label:
Use-Case Expansion /
Cross-Sell
nodes.description: No flow encourages riders to try a different use case (e.g. a house-mover trying a day trip).

nodes.label:
Predictive
Recommendations
nodes.description: Salesforce Predictive Intelligence attributes exist on the account (98 attributes, provisioned 2016) but show no evidence of active scoring or use in any journey.

nodes.label:
Meta Audience Sync
(daily)
nodes.description: GC_MetaAudiences automation, runs daily, builds app-install and FTU-status segments for Meta ad targeting/exclusion.

nodes.label:
Meta Ads
Retargeting
nodes.description: External system — Meta Ads platform receiving the synced audiences.

nodes.label: Reactivation Flow
nodes.note: Built, sitting in Draft — never activated
nodes.description: A Reactivation journey exists in Journey Builder but has never been switched on.

nodes.label: Winback
nodes.description: No dedicated winback incentive flow exists for lapsed riders.

nodes.label:
Final Preference /
Consent Check
nodes.description: No flow re-confirms marketing preferences before a contact is treated as fully churned.
